from jira import JIRA

# 1. Connect to Jira Cloud
jira_url = "https://your-domain.atlassian.net"
email = "your-email@example.com"
api_token = "your_atlassian_api_token"

jira = JIRA(server=jira_url, basic_auth=(email, api_token))

# 2. Define ticket details
issue_data = {
    "project": {"key": "PROJ"},  # Replace with your Project Key
    "summary": "Automated Ticket: Server CPU High",
    "description": "This ticket was automatically generated by a Python script.",
    "issuetype": {"name": "Task"},  # e.g., 'Bug', 'Task', 'Story'
    # Optional fields:
    # "priority": {"name": "High"},
    # "labels": ["automated", "monitoring"],
}

# 3. Create the ticket
try:
    new_issue = jira.create_issue(fields=issue_data)
    print(f"Ticket created successfully! Key: {new_issue.key}")
    print(f"Link: {jira_url}/browse/{new_issue.key}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Failed to create ticket: {e}")
